corpus.description: Expanded developer grammar comparison: original64 baseline cases plus94 author-first arXiv observations.56 self-contained arXiv sentences have pre-reviewed, nonexhaustive minimal references;38 excerpts or interpretation-dependent passages are exploratory and unscored. This is not a representative held-out benchmark. ArXiv mathematical typography is normalized but formula glyphs are not replaced with MATH: inspect protected-text changes for formatting or unsupported-character effects, not automatically semantic damage.

review_notes: All 27 have at least one clear grammatical or construction error in the local sentence; no sentence is labelled ungrammatical solely because of mathematical shorthand or an optional style preference.
ARXIV-055 has several grammatical repairs of the condition; additional semantically equivalent outputs require human review.
ARXIV-085 articles are explicitly optional because mathematical domain labels can be bare.
ARXIV-088 allows deleting of or restoring the evident variable R; exact intended original wording is unknowable, but both references preserve the stated mathematics.
No model outputs were consulted when setting these references.
All references were fixed before any expanded-run model outputs were available.
The three earlier context-dependent full sentences and all35 incomplete excerpts are unscored; results are displayed for review only.
The arXiv set contains known error candidates only. False alarms are measured by the original32 correct baseline controls, not by this all-error collection.
Strict protected strings include mathematical typography. Formatting-only edits can trigger review flags; do not call all such flags mathematical corruption.
No thresholds, prompts or model options were tuned on this expanded collection.
